doc.description:
Ublox GPS autoconfiguration.
Automatically configure any Ublox GPS for paparazzi, for any firmware and INS.
- automatic baudrate detection (the target baudrate first), then sets the target baudrate - configures the navigation messages and rates, the dynamic model and the 3D fix mode
The configuration interface is detected from the protocol version (UBX-MON-VER): receivers without the legacy UBX-CFG messages (protocol 40 and later, e.g. X20) are configured with UBX-CFG-VALSET, the others with the legacy messages (generation 9 also with UBX-CFG-VALSET when it doesn't answer the UBX-CFG-PRT poll). Over I2C the legacy messages are used. With UBX-CFG-VALSET, NAV-PVT is the only navigation message, plus NAV-SAT, NAV-RELPOSNED with RTCM and NAV-DAHEADING (dual antenna heading of the X20D).
Warning: you still need to tell the driver, which paparazzi port you use.

define.name: GPS_UBX_UCENTER_RATE
define.description: Measurement period [ms]. Default 250 with the legacy messages and 100 with UBX-CFG-VALSET (200 when the receiver refuses it)

define.name: GPS_UBX_NAV5_DYNAMICS
define.description: Dynamic model used by ublox GPS filter. Default:NAV5_DYN_AIRBORNE_2G

define.name: GPS_UBX_UCENTER_SAVE
define.description: Save the configuration (default TRUE): battery backed RAM and flash with the legacy messages, battery backed RAM with UBX-CFG-VALSET

define.name: GPS_UBX_UCENTER_UART
define.description: With UBX-CFG-VALSET: receiver UART the autopilot is connected to (default 1), the legacy receivers report it. UART2 of the X20D is input only (corrections)

define.name: USE_GPS_UBX_RTCM
define.description: RTK: output NAV-RELPOSNED (and with the legacy messages also HPPOSLLH and RXM-RTCM, DGNSS mode RTK fixed)

define.name: GPS_UBX_UCENTER_PVT_ONLY
define.description: Legacy messages: only NAV-PVT (and NAV-SAT) instead of POSLLH, VELNED, STATUS, SOL and SVINFO

define.name: GPS_UBX_UCENTER_SLOW_NAV_SOL
define.description: Legacy messages: NAV-SOL at every 8th solution

define.name: USE_GPS_UBX_RXM_RAW
define.description: Legacy messages: raw measurements (only available on U-Blox T versions)

define.name: DEBUG_GPS_UBX_UCENTER
define.description: Send the replies of the configuration steps in a DEBUG message
